contradictions.description: Fact F2 states the UPS carried the load for 15 minutes before generators took over, while Fact F14 states the UPS carried the load for only 9 minutes before Generator B was started.
Fact F6 claims Failover to Generator B was approved by Priya Raman, Operations Lead, whereas Fact F15 claims the failover was approved by Daniel Okafor, Operations Lead.

Fact F27 states Generator B’s tank held roughly 20% at the start of the incident, enough for about 3 hours, while Fact F21 states the tank held roughly 11 hours of runtime at the start of the incident.
Fact F31 reports clear skies, no precipitation, and no wind above 12 km/h on the night of 13 to 14 March, whereas Fact F7 claims the utility fault was triggered by a storm.
Fact F35 states 38 premium-tier customers were affected, while Fact F24 states 41 premium-tier customers were affected.
Fact F3 says normal service was restored at 06:34, but Fact F18 says the utility feed was restored at 08:05, implying service was restored before the feed.
